protocol.harmonic_policy: H1 through min(30,floor(8000/f0)); DC/ramp plus independent cosine/sine/ramp per harmonic; no tuning, delay, cutoff or phase fitting
protocol.mask_policy: Eligibility determined only by phase0: >-45 dB relative to H1 and amplitude >=1e-8. Identical selected harmonics for every phase, no candidate activity mask.
protocol.validity_policy: Full rank; condition<=100; variance>=1e-12; H1 amplitude>=1e-8; residual/variance<=.01. Summary uses only windows valid for ALL four phases. Every invalid window retained with reasons.
protocol.qualification: Changing waveform origin also changes finite attack/filter transients. Harmonic quadrature removes constant phase from the estimator, but cannot remove real phase-dependent dynamics or bias from a short moving-signal window. No late chords fitted by this single-fundamental estimator.
